question: What is the value of frac{{84 div 12 times 3 - 4 div 12 times 9 + 5 times 6 - 2 times 3}}{{8 div 12 times 3}} ?
solution:
**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa34662d5120a932eb2ebb4b2867cbaa9bca446cd111a74e76e9ee4ad42b0ba0.png] 

**Calculations:**

[(84 ÷ 12) × 3 - (4 ÷ 12) × 9 + 5 × 6 - 2 × 3] ÷ [(8 ÷ 12) × 3]

⇒ [7 × 3 - (1/3) × 9 + 30 - 6] ÷ [(2/3) × 3]

⇒ [21 - 3 + 24] ÷ [2]

⇒ [18 + 24] ÷ [2]

⇒ 42 ÷ 2 = 21

**∴ The value of the given equation is 21.**
